title: P015/B001 freeze → final FEMM → bench acceptance
B001_required: Br at reference temperature or demagnetization curve
P015_required: winding wire part no and conductor diameter incl insulation
FEMM_acceptance: evaluate force over full 10 mm functional stroke and relevant temperature/material states
nominal 1 A minimum force coefficient K_F,min ≥0.930895 N/A
1.25 A remains reserve/boost, not basis for nominal release
bench_acceptance: no rub against P007 over stroke
rule: FEMM runner shall fail closed if required production inputs are OPEN.
